text:
sujay: Heads-up — planning to roll SDK client v3.2 to hosted next Tue 09:00 PDT. Need a deploy owner + smoke owners. Primary goals: ensure binary/backward compat for existing clients, no breaking proxy changes, and graceful rollback if anything spikes. :eyes:

maria: I can own the smoke checklist and docs updates. Will update migration guide with the non-breaking notes and the changelog entry today.

tom: I can run the deploy (CI -> blue/green) and watch the canary for the first 10 mins. I'll need someone to watch client errors/telemetry.

kevin: I'll be on-call for the window. Which metrics should I prioritize? CPU/TPS or 5xxs? :warning:

maria: Primary: client 4xx/5xx rate, median latency p50/p95, auth failures. Also watch SDK telemetry for method-level errors and de-serialization exceptions. I'll add custom dashboards and a Delta alert for +3x baseline 5xxs.

olivia: I'll ping Support and DevEx for the client comms thread. We should ship a short note for customers with pinned migration steps and an opt-out flag. I can prepare the email and forum post.

(small checklist):
- deploy owner: tom
- smoke owner: maria
- rollbacks: tom + kevin
- client comms: olivia + maria
- docs: maria

maria: Proposed smoke steps (short):
1) Canary 1% for 10 mins; run the quick SDK sanity tests (auth, generate, embeddings).
2) Validate telemetry: no spike in method-level errors, auth failures, or malformed responses.
3) Increase to 20% for 10 mins if clean.
4) Ramp to 100% over 20 mins with manual pauses at 50% and 80%.

maria: Quick commands we'll use in the smoke run:
```bash
# sanity generation check
curl -sS -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-bert-small","input":"smoke test"}'
```

maria: And a minimal embeddings check:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY' -d '{"input":"smoke"}'
```

tom: For rollback readiness: plan is trivial — revert traffic split in the proxy, and redeploy previous SDK runtime image to the gateway if a config change caused it. I'll keep the previous image tag pinned and a rollback playbook open.

kevin: Add a quick runbook note: if 5xx > 3x baseline for 5m during ramp, immediately rollback to previous split and escalate to oncall. Also capture a few failing request IDs for triage.

olivia: Client comms: we should include an opt-out env var flag and a short code snippet for users to pin the old client until they opt into 3.2. I'll draft that.

sujay: Two small compatibility callouts from infra side:
- No schema changes to the token payload — compatibility should be preserved.
- We changed default HTTP connection pooling in the new client; watch for connection reuse errors in proxies. If we see connection reset patterns, rollback.

maria: Code review status — two PRs blocking the rollout:
- PR #4123: SDK-bindings: small header change (needs 1 more reviewer)
- PR #4130: Canary routing daemon: add traffic-split metric (needs QA signoff)

maria: @tom can you ping the reviewers for #4123? It's small and affects telemetry headers.

tom: On it. Also pinging QA for #4130 — will ask for a focused run on canary metric correctness.
deploy-bot: CI passed for main branch, canary pipeline green, integration tests: 184/187 passing (2 flaky, 1 unrelated). :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll be online from 08:30 PDT and will join the deploy channel. Please post the exact deployment start time 30 min prior.

olivia: I'll prepare the customer note draft by EOD and share it here for a quick review.

sujay: Thanks — if there are no blockers, final plan: Tue 09:00 PDT start, tom drives deploy, maria smoke, kevin oncall, olivia client comms. Rollback: revert traffic split + redeploy previous gateway image. Everyone ok with that? :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

tom: :rocket:

kevin: :+1:

olivia: :ok_hand: 

sujay: I'll update the calendar invite and add the runbook link here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sdk-rollout-v3.2 — ping if anything changes.

maria: FYI — I'll leave a short postmortem template in the runbook to capture any regressions or client reports post-rollout.

sujay: Perfect. Closing this thread for now; reopen if any blocker appears.
